description: A Perl script that generates a mime.conf configuration file for lighttpd by processing /etc/mime.types and adding custom mappings, with logic for conflict resolution and output formatting.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns a MIME type to a file extension, updating internal hashes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a MIME type for a file extension, handling conflicts and precedence rules.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Outputs a formatted line mapping a file extension to a MIME type, appending charset for text types.
